newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal CPI growth to ease despite May gain -Bank.
newsitem.headline: Portugal CPI growth to ease despite May gain -Bank.

text.p: The rise in the year-on-year inflation rate in May, compared with April, is compatible with an easing in the average rate over the coming months, the Bank of Portugal said in its latest monthly report.
In May, the consumer price index rose 0.7 percent month-on-month for a year-on-year rate of 2.1 percent, up from 1.8 percent in April.
The Bank said that non-tradable goods prices rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in May against 4.2 percent in April.
In January-May 1997, private sector salaries rose 3.6 percent against 4.5 percent in the same 1996 period, it said.
